question: What is the definition of a company under the Income Tax Act for corporation tax?
answer: Under Section 2 of the Income Tax Act, a company is defined as a body of persons corporate or unincorporated, whether created or recognized under the law in force in Uganda or elsewhere, and includes a unit trust, but does not include any other trust or a partnership. Accordingly, limited liability companies, companies limited by guarantee, incorporated associations, and Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs) are taxed under the company taxation regime.
question_lg: Kkampuni ennyonnyolwa etya wansi w'etteeka lya Income Tax Act ku musolo gwa kkampuni?
answer_lg: Wansi w'Ekitundu 2 (Section 2) eky'etteeka lya Income Tax Act, kkampuni ennyonnyolwa ng'ekibiina ky'abantu ekyawandiisibwa oba ekitawandiisibwa, ekikolebwa oba ekimanyiddwa wansi w'amateeka agali mu nkola mu Uganda oba awalala, era kizingiramu ne unit trust, naye tekyingiramu trust endala yonna oba partnership. N'olwekyo, amakampuni aga limited liability, amakampuni aga limited by guarantee, ebibiina ebiwandiise, n'ebitongole ebitakolera magoba (NGOs) bisoloozebwako omusolo wansi w'enkola y'okusolooza emisolo ku makampuni.
question_sw: Kampuni inafafanuliwaje chini ya Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato kwa madhumuni ya kodi ya mashirika?
answer_sw: Chini ya Kifungu cha 2 (Section 2) cha Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato, kampuni inafafanuliwa kama shirika la watu lililojumuishwa au ambalo halijajumuishwa, liwe limeundwa au kutambuliwa chini ya sheria inayotumika Uganda au kwingineko, na inajumuisha unit trust, lakini haijumuishi trust nyingine yoyote au ubia. Hivyo, kampuni zenye dhima ndogo, kampuni zenye kikomo cha dhamana, mashirika yaliyosajiliwa, na Mashirika Yasiyo ya Kiserikali (NGOs) hutozwa kodi chini ya mfumo wa kodi ya kampuni.

question: What is the basis of corporation tax?
answer: Both resident and non-resident companies are assessable (subject) to tax in Uganda on their income derived from Uganda, while resident companies are additionally subject to tax on their worldwide income. Income tax paid by companies is officially referred to as corporation tax.
question_lg: Musinji ki ogugobererwa ku musolo gwa kkampuni (corporation tax)?
answer_lg: Amakampuni ag'omu ggwanga (resident) n'ag'ebweru (non-resident) gonna gasoloozebwako omusolo mu Uganda ku nnyingiza yaago eva mu Uganda, ate amakampuni ag'omu ggwanga gasoloozebwako n'omusolo ku nnyingiza yaago okuva mu nsi yonna. Omusolo gw'ennyingiza ogusasulwa amakampuni mu butongole guyitibwa corporation tax.
question_sw: Msingi wa kodi ya mashirika (corporation tax) ni upi?
answer_sw: Kampuni za ndani (resident) na za kigeni (non-resident) zote zinatozwa kodi nchini Uganda kwa mapato yao yanayotokana na Uganda, huku kampuni za ndani zikitozwa kodi ya ziada kwa mapato yao ya ulimwengu mzima. Kodi ya mapato inayolipwa na makampuni huitwa rasmi corporation tax.

question: What is the legal basis and rate of corporation tax?
answer: Income tax on companies is imposed under the Income Tax Act on every corporate entity that has chargeable income for any year of income. The standard statutory corporation tax rate is thirty percent (30%) charged on net profits from business (Chargeable Income) for both resident and non-resident companies.
question_lg: Musinji ki ogw'amateeka n'omuwendo gw'omusolo gwa kkampuni?
answer_lg: Omusolo gw'ennyingiza ku makampuni gussibwawo wansi w'etteeka lya Income Tax Act ku buli kkampuni erina ennyingiza esoloozebwako omusolo mu mwaka gw'ennyingiza. Omuwendo ogw'amateeka ogwa corporation tax guli ebitundu asatu ku buli kikumi (30%) ku magoba agasigaddewo mu bizinensi (Chargeable Income) ku makampuni ag'omu ggwanga n'ag'ebweru.
question_sw: Je, ni msingi gani wa kisheria na kiwango cha kodi ya mashirika?
answer_sw: Kodi ya mapato ya kampuni inatozwa chini ya Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato kwa kila shirika lenye mapato yanayotozwa kodi kwa mwaka wowote wa mapato. Kiwango rasmi cha kisheria cha kodi ya mashirika ni asilimia thelathini (30%) inayotozwa kwa faida halisi ya biashara (Chargeable Income) kwa kampuni za ndani na za kigeni.

question: How is a company's tax liability determined under URA corporation tax rules?
answer: A company determines chargeable income by aggregating gross trading revenue and other income, then deducting cost of sales and allowable operational/administrative overheads, and multiplying net profit by 30%. For example: Gross sales of goods (UGX 200,000,000) + Other income such as subletting space (UGX 39,000,000) = Total revenue of UGX 239,000,000. Less Production costs of UGX 34,000,000 (Purchases 15M, Direct labour 14M, Direct overheads 5M) and Administrative overheads of UGX 16,000,000 (Salaries, utilities, rent) = Total allowable costs of UGX 50,000,000. Chargeable Income (Net profit) = UGX 189,000,000. Corporation Tax at 30% = UGX 56,700,000.
question_lg: Omusolo gwa kkampuni gubalirirwa gutya wansi w'amateeka ga URA?
answer_lg: Kkampuni ebala ennyingiza ebalirirwako omusolo ng'egatta ssente zonna ezivudde mu kutunda n'ennyingiza endala, olwo n'eggyako ebyasaasaanyiziddwa mu kutambuza bizinensi ebikkirizibwa, n'ekubisa amagoba agasigaddewo mu 30%. Okugeza: Ssente z'okutunda ebintu (UGX 200,000,000) + Ennyingiza endala nga ssente z'okupangisa ekifo (UGX 39,000,000) = Ssente zonna ezayingira UGX 239,000,000. N'oggyako ebyasaasaanyiziddwa mu kukola ebintu UGX 34,000,000 (Okugula 15M, Abakozi 14M, Ebyasaasaanyiziddwa eby'obutereevu 5M) n'ebyasaasaanyiziddwa mu kuddukanya ofiisi UGX 16,000,000 (Misaala, masannyalaze, ssente z'obupangisa) = Ebyasaasaanyiziddwa ebyakkirizibwa byonna UGX 50,000,000. Ennyingiza ebalirirwako omusolo (Net profit) = UGX 189,000,000. Omusolo gwa Corporation Tax ku 30% = UGX 56,700,000.
question_sw: Je, dhima ya kodi ya kampuni inatambuliwaje chini ya sheria za URA za kodi ya mashirika?
answer_sw: Kampuni huhesabu mapato yanayotozwa kodi kwa kujumlisha mapato ghafi ya biashara na mapato mengine, kisha kutoa gharama za mauzo na gharama za uendeshaji zinazoruhusiwa, na kuzidisha faida halisi kwa 30%. Kwa mfano: Mauzo ghafi ya bidhaa (UGX 200,000,000) + Mapato mengine kama vile kupangisha nafasi (UGX 39,000,000) = Jumla ya mapato ya UGX 239,000,000. Kutoa gharama za uzalishaji za UGX 34,000,000 (Manunuzi 15M, Kazi ya moja kwa moja 14M, Gharama za moja kwa moja 5M) na gharama za utawala za UGX 16,000,000 (Mishahara, huduma, kodi ya pango) = Jumla ya gharama zinazoruhusiwa za UGX 50,000,000. Mapato Yanayotozwa Kodi (Faida halisi) = UGX 189,000,000. Kodi ya Shirika kwa 30% = UGX 56,700,000.

question: Where is official URA guidance on Corporation Tax published?
answer: Official guidance on company income tax is published under Tax Education and General Tax Information at https://ura.go.ug/en/corporation-tax/ and https://ura.go.ug/en/category/tax-education/general-tax-information/corporation-tax/ (published June 20, 2024 by Esther Watsemwa).
question_lg: Obulagirizi obw'obutongole obwa URA ku musolo gwa kkampuni bufulumizibwa wa?
answer_lg: Obulagirizi obw'obutongole ku musolo gw'ennyingiza ya kkampuni bufulumizibwa wansi wa Tax Education ne General Tax Information ku https://ura.go.ug/en/corporation-tax/ ne https://ura.go.ug/en/category/tax-education/general-tax-information/corporation-tax/ (bwafulumizibwa June 20, 2024 Esther Watsemwa).
question_sw: Mwongozo rasmi wa URA kuhusu Kodi ya Mashirika unachapishwa wapi?
answer_sw: Mwongozo rasmi wa kodi ya mapato ya kampuni unachapishwa chini ya Elimu ya Kodi na Taarifa za Jumla za Kodi kwenye https://ura.go.ug/en/corporation-tax/ na https://ura.go.ug/en/category/tax-education/general-tax-information/corporation-tax/ (ilichapishwa Juni 20, 2024 na Esther Watsemwa).
